name: Curse of Belittling
description:
While worn, you are 12.5% smaller and lose 12.5% attack damage.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 1.5❤️[/dark-red] to inflict cosmic insignificance for 12 seconds, reducing enemy size and speed by 20% and doubling damage of curses and punches against them.
